subject.title: /stop abort leaves streaming card in idle state, blocking subsequent messages (replies=0)

question: Should this repair live in shared reply-run abort admission, Feishu streaming-card cleanup, or a coordinated change across both surfaces?
rationale: The issue has source-visible shared abort behavior and Feishu-specific CardKit symptoms, but no live Feishu trace proving which boundary owns the stale state.

options.title: Trace Feishu Then Fix Shared/Plugin Boundary
options.body: Capture a current Feishu `/stop` repro and land the smallest fix in the boundary that actually retains the stale operation or card state.

options.title: Fix Shared Abort Admission First
options.body: Treat the active-abort zero-reply path as a shared runtime bug and then add Feishu proof to catch any remaining card cleanup issue.

options.title: Route To Feishu Plugin Only
options.body: Limit the repair to Feishu streaming-card reset if live evidence shows shared reply-run state is behaving as intended.

recommendation.title: Trace Feishu Then Fix Shared/Plugin Boundary
recommendation.body: Capture a current Feishu `/stop` repro and land the smallest fix in the boundary that actually retains the stale operation or card state.

likelyOwner.reason: The current shared reply dispatch and abort test path is the central cross-channel decision point before a Feishu-only owner can be chosen.
